protocol.oracle: Go host on the same frozen inputs; JavaScript fallback if Go generation fails
protocol.statistic: median of successful Rust backend generations, each byte-exact to the oracle
protocol.order: serialized packages, frontend outside timing, one oracle and one Rust warmup before measured Rust runs
protocol.excludes: frontend, compiler/application builds, application execution and process startup/exit
protocol.cache: fresh generated output and PBO caches for each process, warm OS filesystem cache
protocol.scope: Only unmeasured gopurs-* Rust cells; existing JS/Go and gopurs-aff cells keep their previous campaigns. No new cross-host speed-ratio claim.
